question: Should `2026.7.1-2` replace the current gateway LKG before its upstream startup concern is resolved or explicitly accepted and the Windows/WSL acceptance matrix is evidenced?
rationale: This is a release-promotion decision: the one-line code change cannot establish that the candidate is last known good for supported setup and repair environments.

options.title: Hold the existing LKG pending acceptance
options.body: Keep the current default until the startup report receives a documented disposition and current-head Windows/WSL evidence demonstrates setup, health, pairing, repair, and rollback.

options.title: Accept the candidate risk explicitly
options.body: Promote `2026.7.1-2` with a release-owner rationale that accepts the unresolved startup uncertainty and documents the limited evidence.

recommendation.title: Hold the existing LKG pending acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the current default until the startup report receives a documented disposition and current-head Windows/WSL evidence demonstrates setup, health, pairing, repair, and rollback.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review supplies the concrete LKG acceptance criteria and identifies the release-quality decision still outstanding.
